metadata.question: Does the water storage in Alabama decreases from 2003 to 2012?

data.raw_code: The user is asking: "Does the water storage in Alabama decreases from 2003 to 2012?" This is a question about changes in terrestrial water storage over time. I need to: 1. Search Strategy: - Use GRACE (Gravity Recovery and Climate Experiment) data for water storage - GRACE provides terrestrial water storage anomaly data - Date range: 2003 and 2012 (annual averages or specific periods) - Location: Alabama (US state) 2. Data Source Options: - NASA GRACE Mascon product: 'NASA/GRACE/MASS_GRIDS/MASCON' - GRACE Level-3 data: 'NASA/GRACE/GRACE_L3_CSR_RL06' - Time period: GRACE mission started 2002, so 2003-2012 is covered 3. Approach: - Get Alabama geometry from TIGER/2018/States - Filter GRACE collection for 2003 and 2012 - Compute mean water storage anomaly for each year - Compare if 2012 value is lower than 2003 value - Account for data gaps and validation 4. Potential Issues: - GRACE has monthly data, need to aggregate to annual mean - Data might have gaps in some months - Need to check if collection is empty - Need to check if valid pixels exist after masking 5. Logic for Answer: - If 2012 mean water storage < 2003 mean water storage: A (Yes) - Else: B (No) - Handle cases C1, C2, C3 as needed Let me structure the code accordingly. ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions // Get Alabama geometry from US Census data const states = ee.FeatureCollection('TIGER/2018/States'); const alabama = states.filter(ee.Filter.eq('NAME', 'Alabama')); // Define time periods: full years 2003 and 2012 const start2003 = '2003-01-01'; const end2003 = '2003-12-31'; const start2012 = '2012-01-01'; const end2012 = '2012-12-31'; // 2. Data Acquisition - Using GRACE Mascon product for water storage const grace2003 = ee.ImageCollection('NASA/GRACE/MASS_GRIDS/MASCON') .filterDate(start2003, end2003) .select('lwe_thickness'); // Liquid water equivalent thickness (anomaly) const grace2012 = ee.ImageCollection('NASA/GRACE/MASS_GRIDS/MASCON') .filterDate(start2012, end2012) .select('lwe_thickness'); // Check for empty collections const count2003 = grace2003.size().getInfo(); const count2012 = grace2012.size().getInfo(); console.log(`2003 Images: ${count2003}`); console.log(`2012 Images: ${count2012}`); if (count2003 === 0 || count2012 === 0) { console.log(`C1`); return; } // Compute annual mean images const mean2003 = grace2003.mean(); const mean2012 = grace2012.mean(); // 3. Check for valid pixels const scale = 50000; // GRACE resolution is about 300km, using 50km scale const countStats2003 = mean2003.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: alabama, scale: scale, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('lwe_thickness').getInfo(); const countStats2012 = mean2012.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: alabama, scale: scale, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('lwe_thickness').getInfo(); console.log(`2003 Valid Pixels: ${countStats2003}`); console.log(`2012 Valid Pixels: ${countStats2012}`); if (countStats2003 === 0 || countStats2012 === 0) { console.log(`C2`); return; } // 4. Calculation - Get mean water storage anomaly for each year const meanVal2003 = mean2003.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: alabama, scale: scale, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('lwe_thickness').getInfo(); const meanVal2012 = mean2012.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: alabama, scale: scale, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('lwe_thickness').getInfo(); console.log(`2003 Mean Water Storage Anomaly: ${meanVal2003 ? meanVal2003.toFixed(4) : 'null'} m`); console.log(`2012 Mean Water Storage Anomaly: ${meanVal2012 ? meanVal2012.toFixed(4) : 'null'} m`); // 5. Validation & Final Answer if (meanVal2003 === null || meanVal2012 === null || !isFinite(meanVal2003) || !isFinite(meanVal2012)) { console.log(`C3`); return; } // Check if water storage decreased (2012 < 2003) // Since these are anomalies in meters of water equivalent, negative means below baseline const change = meanVal2012 - meanVal2003; console.log(`Change (2012-2003): ${change.toFixed(4)} m`); if (meanVal2012 < meanVal2003) { console.log(`A`); } else { console.log(`B`); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
